bestBets.overview: 1000m QTIS 3yo Maiden. With the rail out 8m only a dozen can run. As things stand nine will be on debut and one will be 1st-up from a spell. METRIC strips fitter boasts the Saturday winning form-line of Queen Olympias, but keep in mind 2nd and 3rd had no luck in that race. The good news is all the newcomers have had at least one public trial, and in recent times so there's less guesswork in the opening prices than is often enough the case. On the flip-side none of the trials were conducted on this track so all relevance is diluted. All things considered with them newbies I've gone with horses trained on the track, CODE KEEPER, PINOT PIRATE, RED POINT, and FLARESSENCE as local knowledge  must count for something. Keeping well and truly out just the same.

raceTips.comment: We race at Eagle Farm on Ekka Wednesday which is a public holiday in Brisbane. This meeting always draws a big crowd & with the sunny mid-20's conditions forecast it should be even larger than usual. We get things underway with a 3yo maiden where we have a mix of raced & unraced runners. I'll lean to Metric who was well supported on debut when parked 3 deep, stuck it out to the end though & that race produced a winner her on Saturday. Copper Chase maybe best of the newcomers?

bestBets.overview: 1200m Maiden Plate. No's 2,9,10,11,14 looks to be where the pace resides in what looks to be a race full of possibilities.  BAD BOSS had no favours 1st-up when unplaced around Doomben, give another chance. BEAT THE RAP close up both starts (both at Ipswich). Maps a treat for Jimmy Orman. INDAMOUSE went good at its home last start. LIPPIZANER didn't get an even break when 3rd here last start, can be even fitter for that. MORE REVOLUTION came in for good support when on debut seven weeks ago. Filed under where there's smoke etc and the effort was okay. RUM AND KIRK went close when resuming at Grafton, not sure about the strength of the form. The stablemate SORRENTI did well when resuming a gelding, but could be it ain't running? (wide draw, no rider). IGNATIUS came in for good support on debut but mucked up the start, must be given another look. THREEEYEDWITCH draws the best, fitter again, another that could be winning. Wide open affair, seek value.

bestBets.overview: 1200m Maiden Plate for the fairer sex in what also looks a competitive line-up. Fourteen can run and at typing time four had already opted out, hence fourteen remain. No's 4,12,16,17,18 most likely to be looking to lead or posi close in transit.  As things stand Hoysted is good for three as is Gollan. That's almost half the field from just two yards. AGADOO has had no luck latest two, deserves to be breaking through here. CARPET RIDE ran well off the lengthy spell, can go one better. The stablemate EMPHATIQUE placed both this time in, neither had an even break. IRREVERENT new blood resuming for Gollan, an obvious market watch.

raceTips.comment: The resuming Pearls In June can run a race here. Very unlucky not to win first up last prep she's run some decent races in her short career to date & is a big chance of getting home over the leaders late should the tempo be genuine or better. Emphatique looks close, sat deep last start & gave plenty in the run to the line, well drawn will gain a much softer run. Gollan stable newcomer Irreverent a market watch, may need the hit out, may not?

bestBets.overview: 1400m C5. No's 1,3,5,6,7 candidates to make the pace, only time will tell who wants it and who is content to sit. LAST COMMAND resumes, can pull out a run fresh, four starts here for two wins and two placings. Market should be a great guide. NAVAL TRADER keeps getting lost in transit this time in, forgivable all three. If they are running on, this should. FREELAND ran on well off an indifferent start when resuming. TOO MANY THOUGHTS was something of a trainwreck in the run home last start, looked to be room to its right but the rider couldn't or wouldn't aim there. PUFF 'N' HARRY was unlucky in stronger grade at Doomben two starts ago. Another race that has all the feels of 'respecting the betting'. Right now I am saying there's at least five proper chances.Can feel some wild fluctuations coming on.

bestBets.overview: 1200m BM68. As things stand a dozen are running, five of which are returning from a spell. As things stand Gollan is good for three and Waller has a pair hence there's circa 42% of the entire field from just two stables. All eyes and ears to the market moves! Take these big stables on at your peril. Anyway the map says no's 1,5,6,10 should be settling forward. For the record the resuming MIDNIGHT SPIRIT has run well 1st-up all three to date. BEREZKA strips fitter again, takes a claim, drops in class. OUR HUNTRESS is two for two for Ben Thompson, on line for a hat-trick here.  CHATTERLEY resumes, placed all three prior, all in NSW so once again we have Waller taking a more realistic approach to at the very least repay all the owners of which there are enough to choke a cow. FIREFORCE resumes, ran very well 1st-up last time in and that was this track/distance. SIESTA partakes an in-form runner, only the third run in today and is very very very nicely in after the claim. Should be winning.

raceTips.comment: With Berezka scratched from the race I'll lean to one who was also recently scratched & that's Siesta who came out of a race here on Saturday when drawn poorly. Will race on speed & has shown plenty at her only two local outings. Although widely drawn I'd keep Chatterley safe fresh.

bestBets.overview: 1000m C3 Plate. As things stand Dunn is good for two (and both have riders engaged!) and Gollan is also good for two. So, there's one very good reason to already be watching the market moves more closely, aka a game of Join The Dots. No's 1,2,3,4,6,9,12  bring speed to the race, if they remain it will be on.  Sure sets up well for something to emerge, that's on the understanding the pattern today has been allowing that. All this leads me to the resuming THE POOL BOY. Proven fresh and draws well for R Maloney, a rider who is never shy to watch it all unfold and only push the button when said button well and truly needs a push. LIGHTS OF PARADISE creates plenty of interest. Can sit back and run on well fresh, hasn't started for 59 weeks hence one trusts the fluctuations. BIANCELLI is freshened new blood, is weighted to beat them all. Question is why did Mick Price & Kent Jnr show it the stable door?

bestBets.overview: 1000m C6 Hcp. As things stand a dozen will clash, no fewer than seven will be returning from a spell so the market moves as they make their way to te barriers can shed light as to which stables have put in the necessary work and which have not. No's 2,6,7,11,12,13 usually like to set the pace hence the speed should be hot. Sets up well for the resuming MOONHAVEN which just so happens to be two from five fresh and is two from three on this very track. The stablemate ACRES AWAY is also resuming, is three from six fresh, is drawn to ensure Jimmy Orman earns his supper. EISHA was well fancied when resuming, wasn't far off at the finish, dare say will be better for that. MISS PERSONALITY resumes, a proven 1st-upper winning three from four but the draw is cruel. She's never drawn worse than Doctor Bevan, her five wins have come from barriers 1-4. All that speed will suit PORT ERIN. He too resumes, he's proven here.

raceTips.comment: Esha is going to improve plenty fitness wise from her first local start here recently in Saturday company. Not the soundest of mares being very lightly raced she fought on well however just peaked late with the 60kg. Down in the weights off an inside draw she's going to get plenty of favours in the run. Miss Personality is a smart type resuming, gate no favour however in good hands. Moonhaven capable of a big run fresh.
